parameters.query:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(NULLIF(m.key->>'remoteJidAlt', ''), m.key->>'remoteJid') AS remote_jid,
    m."pushName"           AS msg_push_name,
    c."pushName"           AS contact_push_name,
    m."messageTimestamp"   AS ts,
    (m.key->>'fromMe')::boolean AS from_me,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(m.key->>'remoteJidAlt', ''), m.key->>'remoteJid')
      ORDER BY m."messageTimestamp" DESC
    ) AS latest_rn,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(m.key->>'remoteJidAlt', ''), m.key->>'remoteJid')
      ORDER BY (m.key->>'fromMe')::boolean ASC, m."messageTimestamp" DESC
    ) AS incoming_rn
  FROM "Message" m
  JOIN "Instance" i ON i."id" = m."instanceId"
  LEFT JOIN "Contact" c
    ON (c."remoteJid" = m.key->>'remoteJid' OR c."remoteJid" = m.key->>'remoteJidAlt')
   AND c."instanceId" = m."instanceId"
  WHERE i."name" = $1
    AND (m.key->>'remoteJid' LIKE '%@s.whatsapp.net' OR m.key->>'remoteJid' LIKE '%@lid')
    AND m.key->>'remoteJid' <> '0@s.whatsapp.net'
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    remote_jid,
    MAX(ts) AS last_message_ts,
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(MAX(contact_push_name), 'Você'),
      NULLIF(MAX(msg_push_name) FILTER (WHERE incoming_rn = 1), 'Você')
    ) AS push_name
  FROM ranked
  GROUP BY remote_jid
)
SELECT
  remote_jid,
  last_message_ts,
  CASE WHEN push_name ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN NULL ELSE push_name END AS push_name,
  CASE WHEN remote_jid LIKE '%@s.whatsapp.net' THEN replace(remote_jid, '@s.whatsapp.net', '') ELSE NULL END AS phone
FROM agg
ORDER BY last_message_ts DESC;

WITH msgs AS (
  SELECT
    (m.key->>'fromMe')::boolean AS from_me,
    m.key->>'id' AS msg_id,
    m."messageTimestamp" AS ts,
    CASE
      WHEN m.message ? 'audioMessage'    THEN '[audio]'
      WHEN m.message ? 'imageMessage'    THEN COALESCE(m.message->'imageMessage'->>'caption', '[imagem]')
      WHEN m.message ? 'videoMessage'    THEN COALESCE(m.message->'videoMessage'->>'caption', '[video]')
      WHEN m.message ? 'stickerMessage'  THEN '[figurinha]'
      WHEN m.message ? 'documentMessage' THEN COALESCE(m.message->'documentMessage'->>'caption', '[documento]')
      WHEN m.message ? 'locationMessage' THEN '[localizacao]'
      WHEN m.message ? 'reactionMessage' THEN '[reacao]'
      WHEN m.message ? 'contactMessage'  THEN COALESCE(m.message->'contactMessage'->>'displayName', '[contato]')
      ELSE COALESCE(
        m.message->>'conversation',
        m.message->'extendedTextMessage'->>'text',
        m.message->'templateMessage'->'hydratedTemplate'->>'hydratedContentText',
        m.message->'templateMessage'->'hydratedTemplate'->>'title'
      )
    END AS body
  FROM "Message" m
  JOIN "Instance" i ON i."id" = m."instanceId"
  WHERE i."name" = $1 AND (m.key->>'remoteJid' = $2 OR m.key->>'remoteJidAlt' = $2)
  AND m."messageTimestamp" > $3
  ORDER BY m."messageTimestamp" DESC
  LIMIT 10000
)
SELECT from_me, msg_id, ts, body FROM msgs
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL::boolean, NULL::text, NULL::int, NULL::text
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM msgs);
